ARCHIVE_SHA = '9a0f1088f7a6d70a2ec17c705a61bdbbb2ea59cb815a3327aec817d0120d05a0'
started = time.monotonic()

def sha(body):
    return hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()

def git(*args, cwd=ROOT):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=cwd)

def blob(revision, name, cwd=ROOT):
    return git('show', revision + ':' + name, cwd=cwd)

def descriptor(name, body):
    return {'path': name, 'sha256': sha(body), 'size_bytes': len(body)}

assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip() == HEAD
assert git('rev-parse', HEAD + '^{tree}') == git('rev-parse', LOCAL + '^{tree}')
before_protected = json.loads((SCRATCH / 'protected-inputs-before.json').read_text())
assert len(before_protected) == 76
assert 'ROADMAP.md' not in before_protected and 'docs/project/roadmap.json' in before_protected
protected = []
for name, expected in sorted(before_protected.items()):
    current = (ROOT / name).read_bytes()
    old = blob(BASE, name)
    published = blob(HEAD, name)
    assert current == old == published
    assert sha(current) == expected
    protected.append({**descriptor(name, current), 'baseline_and_published_bytes_equal': True})

proof_body = (ROOT / 'ci/project/p06_counter_qualification_proof.json').read_bytes()
proof = json.loads(proof_body)
assert len(proof_body) == 123781 and sha(proof_body) == 'd12718e9b182a3c93eab346901b380031516d556dd823017a63831d4a0304b4e'
assert proof_body == blob(ORIGINAL, 'ci/project/p06_counter_qualification_proof.json') == blob(HEAD, 'ci/project/p06_counter_qualification_proof.json')
assert proof['reviewed_source_revision'] == BASE
archive_before = descriptor(ARCHIVE.name, ARCHIVE.read_bytes())
assert archive_before['sha256'] == ARCHIVE_SHA and archive_before['size_bytes'] == 41577668
measurement = []
dependencies = []
diagnostics = []
ramulator = ROOT / 'third_party/ramulator'
dependency_revision = proof['dependency_revision']
assert dependency_revision == 'e62c84a6f0e06566ba6e182d308434b4532068a5'
for revision in (BASE, ORIGINAL, HEAD):
    assert git('rev-parse', revision + ':third_party/ramulator').decode().strip() == dependency_revision
assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD', cwd=ramulator).decode().strip() == dependency_revision
with zipfile.ZipFile(ARCHIVE) as archive:
    native_body = archive.read('native-qualification/report.json')
    assert sha(native_body) == '576b77872d6b918e3dbe30cef4107481f39ee73c346a813562e7e916b2afd7c4'
    native = json.loads(native_body)
    source_body = archive.read('native-qualification/' + native['source_before']['path'])
    assert descriptor(native['source_before']['path'], source_body) == native['source_before']
    source = json.loads(source_body)
    source_rows = {row['path']: row for row in source['files']}
    dependency_body = archive.read('dependency-build/report.json')
    assert sha(dependency_body) == '5b754be521277cd133ea28a8c1cac3e71105639a2e3cd314bf1ca9db6c8a4dbc'
    dependency = json.loads(dependency_body)
    component = next(row for row in dependency['source_manifest']['sources'] if row['name'] == 'ramulator')
    assert component['revision'] == dependency_revision
    assert component['tree'] == git('rev-parse', dependency_revision + '^{tree}', cwd=ramulator).decode().strip()
    component_rows = {row['path']: row for row in component['files']}
    for row in proof['measurement_sources']:
        name = row['path']
        current = (ROOT / name).read_bytes()
        assert descriptor(name, current) == row
        assert current == blob(BASE, name) == blob(HEAD, name)
        retained = archive.read('native-qualification/artifacts/source/' + name)
        assert current == retained and source_rows[name] == row
        measurement.append({**row, 'git_blob': git('rev-parse', HEAD + ':' + name).decode().strip(),
                            'current_baseline_published_and_native_bytes_equal': True})
    for row in proof['dependency_sources']:
        name = row['path']
        object_body = blob(dependency_revision, name, cwd=ramulator)
        current = (ramulator / name).read_bytes()
        retained = archive.read('dependency-build/sources/ramulator/' + name)
        assert descriptor(name, object_body) == {key: row[key] for key in ('path', 'sha256', 'size_bytes')}
        assert object_body == current == retained
        assert git('rev-parse', dependency_revision + ':' + name, cwd=ramulator).decode().strip() == row['git_blob']
        actual = component_rows[name]
        assert actual['sha256'] == row['sha256'] and actual['size_bytes'] == row['size_bytes'] and actual['oid'] == row['git_blob']
        dependencies.append({**row, 'current_pinned_git_and_retained_bytes_equal': True})
    for row in proof['diagnostic_sources']:
        name = row['path']
        current = (ROOT / name).read_bytes()
        assert descriptor(name, current) == row
        assert current == blob(BASE, name) == blob(HEAD, name)
        assert name not in source_rows
        diagnostics.append({**row, 'absent_from_native_source_inventory': True})
assert len(measurement) == 69 and len(dependencies) == 21 and len(diagnostics) == 7

changes = []

    changes.append({'status': status, 'path': name})
assert len(changes) == 82
modified = [row['path'] for row in changes if row['status'] == 'M']
assert set(modified) == {'.github/workflows/project-governance.yml', 'ci/project/p06_dependency_native_replay.py',
    'ci/project/p06_managed_preflight_execute.py', 'ci/project/test_p06_dependency_build.py'}
new_implementation = {
    'ci/project/p06_counter_qualification_' + name + '.py'
    for name in ('admission', 'contract', 'execute', 'prerequisites', 'replay')}
new_test_support = {'ci/project/p06_counter_qualification_test_fixture.py', 'ci/project/test_p06_dependency_replay_extension.py'}
for row in changes:
    name = row['path']
    if row['status'] == 'A':
        assert name in new_implementation | new_test_support | {
            'ci/project/p06_counter_qualification_proof.json', 'docs/designs/complete_counter_qualification_v1.md',
            'docs/project/p06-counter-qualification-audit.md'} or name.startswith((
            'ci/project/test_p06_counter_qualification_', 'docs/project/evidence/p06-counter-qualification/'))
    if name.startswith('ci/') or name.startswith('.github/') or name.startswith('docs/designs/'):
        assert (ROOT / name).read_bytes() == blob(HEAD, name)

shared = {}
for name in modified:
    diff = git('diff', '--no-ext-diff', '--unified=3', BASE, HEAD, '--', name).decode()

old_reader_tree = ast.parse(blob(BASE, 'ci/project/p06_dependency_native_replay.py'))
new_reader_tree = ast.parse(blob(HEAD, 'ci/project/p06_dependency_native_replay.py'))
